slo_title: State and prove De Morgan’s Theorems using Boolean algebra.

mcq.q: Q2. Which of the following statements best explains the essence of De Morgan’s theorems?

options.A: They provide a relationship between AND and OR operations using inversion.
options.B: They simplify only AND operations in Boolean algebra.
options.C: They are valid only for binary addition.
options.D: They eliminate the need for Karnaugh maps.

mcq.answer_text: They provide a relationship between AND and OR operations using inversion.
